name: Earth
notes: Soil, dirt, mud banks, dug graves and earthworks. Non-flammable and smothers fire. Density 1500 kg/m³ (loose soil). Absorbs sound and falls (0.4). Quieter than stone underfoot (−3 dB, audio bible §7.3: dirt below stone). Soft surface that arrows and rope arrows embed in (softAnchor). (mw-e03.31)
